description: This file defines the GatewayConnectivityCoordinator class responsible for managing the network connectivity to a gateway endpoint within an application. It observes state changes, manages endpoint connection tasks, and provides URL host labels; it also communicates with other components via published properties and handles different endpoint states.

classes.name: GatewayConnectivityCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for coordinating connectivity to a gateway endpoint, managing state, and handling connection lifecycle.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the connection process by creating a task that subscribes to endpoint state updates.

methods.name: handleEndpointState
methods.description: Handles the different states of the gateway endpoint, updates properties, and triggers refreshes on endpoint changes.

methods.name: hostLabel
methods.description: Generates a string label for the host based on the URL, including port if present.
